editorial.blurb: HAIBAYÔ is a stunning Uptown gem that transports you to Hanoi with beautifully curated Vietnamese décor, expertly crafted coffee, and a calm, welcoming energy that makes you want to linger.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask the baristas to customize drinks off-menu—they're genuinely accommodating. Arrive ready to explore: the space is bigger than it looks, with a hallway showcasing Vietnamese history and a back section perfect for lingering over mahjong or a DJ event.
signatureDishes: Cà phê sữa (Vietnamese coffee with condensed milk)

topDishes.dish: Cà phê sữa (Vietnamese coffee with condensed milk)
topDishes.note: Perfect balance of sweetness and bitterness, served traditionally with phin drip filter
